chat.description: The chat's key, as the chats tool lists it: "<account>:<chat id>".

before.description: A message's id (the [id] of a line): the page of messages older than it. The previous page ends with the id to give here.

around.description: A message's id: the page centred on it, for an old message the user asks about (from search_chat). Not with before.

limit.description: How many messages: 50 by default, at most 100.
